gaps.sentence: The delays have made the project far more ___ (COST) than planned.
gaps.explanation: 'Far more costly' — the comparative adjective is needed after 'more'.

gaps.sentence: The novel is a ___ (FICTION) account of real events.
A side-by-side ___ (COMPARE) of the two plans reveals clear differences.
gaps.explanation: 'A comparison of X and Y' — the noun form follows the article and adjective.

gaps.sentence: ___ (PERSIST) rain ruined the first two days of the festival.
gaps.explanation: An adjective is needed before 'rain': persistent; 'persistence' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: The bridge has a maximum ___ (WEIGH) of ten tonnes.

gaps.explanation: 'Championship victory' — the title/contest, not the person.

gaps.sentence: He is one of the most ___ (SUCCESS) businessmen in the region.
